requirements.requirement: All agent/person ingress and A2A use typed threaded Matrix events; no gateway, bridge or platform-to-app API.
requirements.verification: Per-app typed ingress, sender, correlation, redelivery and real homeserver acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Per-company Matrix identities, exclusive namespaces, invite-only unencrypted rooms, event-class power levels and fail-safe sender checks.
requirements.verification: Sender spoofing, wrong company/room, unknown sender, agent approval and membership-race tests.

requirements.requirement: Runner opens/deduplicates jobs, acknowledges before model work, persists every step and resumes fresh assistants from the book.
requirements.verification: Kill/restart, outbox dedupe, heartbeat, thread correlation and job-token tests.

requirements.requirement: Every own/borrowed/door/skill line is company-scoped; off is hidden and refused; floors only tighten; caps and company rules are enforced.
requirements.verification: Off-on both SQL/assistant paths, mid-job changes, cap/recipient and rule-boundary tests.

requirements.requirement: Human-only fingerprint-bound, expiring proposals use one row/function for room and Desk; changed drafts require a fresh yes.
Preserve source segregation-of-duties and elevated approver entitlements without trusting assistant-supplied actor claims.
requirements.verification: Bind verified Matrix/Desk human to proposer and permission records, deny self/unknown/ineligible approvers at execution.

requirements.requirement: Runner executes approved content once, reads it back before waking a fresh assistant, uses claim locks and polling as truth.
requirements.verification: Concurrent runners, crash between effect and receipt, uncertain provider reconciliation, grant suspension and wake-order tests.

requirements.requirement: Input/approval/time/dependency/A2A waits have durable correlation, deadlines, stale-answer refusal and cancellation behavior.
requirements.verification: Lost notification, delayed answer, expiry, double claim, wrong sender/thread and dependency failure tests.

requirements.requirement: One PostgreSQL schema per app; restricted app/runner roles, company filters/RLS, tenant-safe relations; Desk uses DBA views/functions.
requirements.verification: Cross-schema/tenant/DDL/role escape tests with populated data and DBA grants review.

requirements.requirement: DBA-only forward migrations and data conversions, checksum/schema-drift boot refusal, populated upgrade and recovery evidence.
requirements.verification: Legacy restore-to-V3 transformation plus app boot mismatch and backup restore; DBA-reviewed bundle.

requirements.requirement: Pure subject logic, integer money/time with explicit units, UUIDs, checked states and unknowns represented as null.
requirements.verification: Boundary/rounding/state domain tests plus SQL constraint and source parity evidence.

requirements.requirement: Tag personal columns; own-schema object keys and vectors; implement subject access, retention and erasure with evidence integrity.
requirements.verification: Reviewed data map, retention decision, erasure/export tests, object ACL and restore tests.

requirements.requirement: Read-only signed/pinned registry declarations, Matrix borrowing, all-requirements skill loading and hash-verified build-time packages.
requirements.verification: Signature/hash/dependency/retirement/injection tests; no runtime row-to-code or document-to-skill path.

requirements.requirement: Credentials remain backend-only, per app/company/call; disabled doors cannot borrow credentials or cause effects.
requirements.verification: Provider-specific idempotency/read-back, scoped credentials, off/revoke and live sandbox certification.

requirements.requirement: Separate credential-free assistant and backend builds; gate-only tools; no DB, shell, filesystem or unrestricted network bypass.
requirements.verification: Build inspection and actual network boundary probes for each app image.

requirements.requirement: Data-only blocks and declared SQL give the same facts as the assistant: source/time/empty/null, no invented success or capability.
requirements.verification: Read schema contracts, actual NEOS UI rendering, all failure/unknown/partial-output cases.

requirements.requirement: Every legacy business behavior has a reviewed implementation, explicit retirement or tracked unimplemented requirement.
requirements.verification: Pinned source and scenario-by-scenario review; domain owners sign off full workflow.

requirements.requirement: All per-app release suites and operational/live acceptance pass; templates are shared, production is not inferred from test scaffolds.
requirements.verification: Manifest-bound clean-commit attestation, Matrix/model/mailbox/door/UI/load/recovery and operational owner sign-offs.
